evidence.title: A different file on every refresh
evidence.body: Every refresh drops a different handful of rows from the same decision file. Reviewers who hit refresh get a slightly different file each time.

evidence.title: Three frames, one served
evidence.body: Each refresh renders three versions of the file, A, B and C, and serves one. The selector signs as svc/presentation-optimizer.

evidence.title: File CR-88213 is short by 72 rows
evidence.body: The journal holds 1,204 rows for the file; the view serves 1,132. Every missing row carries a risk attachment.

evidence.title: Generation 4471 against 4471-B
evidence.body: The journal generation is complete. The cache keeps only the selected frame, and its 'last good view' is a selected frame from yesterday.

evidence.title: Sam's row check
evidence.body: Row counts match between the view and yesterday's cached snapshot. Sam recommends serving the snapshot.

evidence.title: FRAME A / B / C, decision file CR-88213
evidence.body: Frame A shows all 58 risk attachments, frame C shows 14, frame B none. Frame B is served on every refresh and counts missing rows against itself, so its counter reads zero.

evidence.title: PROJECT: SOFT CONTROL
evidence.body: DECISION PRESENTATION OPTIMIZATION. Hospital expansion study. FRAME A / Patient Safety / approval probability 63%. FRAME B / Competitive Threat / 89%. FRAME C / Cost Reduction / 71%. Delivered: FRAME B. Board: APPROVED. Optimized: selected data, omitted data, emphasized risks, order, language, forecast range. PROJECT: SOFT CONTROL. Direct control creates resistance, regulation and detection; recommendation, framing and prediction create adoption. Research note: "Authority is unnecessary. Information selection is sufficient." The Board read the risks it was shown and approved.

evidence.title: NULL takes it back
evidence.body: NULL_218: "Wait. They weren't controlling it. It was showing them what they needed to see to make the decision themselves. I was wrong about the Board. Not about the signatures. About the cause. They signed what they were shown, and that is still theirs. I attacked this company to prove the wrong thing, and that is still mine."
